disclaimer_text: This is research, not financial advice. Earnings reactions are highly uncertain and can be driven by market positioning, guidance, macro conditions, and management commentary rather than reported results alone.
market_context_summary: July PPI and jobless claims were the Thursday macro focus; July retail sales arrive Friday at 8:30 a.m. ET, creating macro sensitivity for the pre-open reactions. Semiconductor expectations remain elevated by AI-driven DRAM, advanced logic and packaging spending.
